questions.q: On 24 May 2025, the Supreme Court overturned the order of which High Court and ruled that denying maternity leave for a third child violates a woman's constitutional rights, reinforcing her dignity and reproductive autonomy?
questions.solution:
The Supreme Court set aside an Allahabad High Court order that had denied maternity leave to a government teacher for her third child.
It held that such denial violates her rights under Articles 14 and 21 and her reproductive autonomy.
**Answer: Allahabad High Court**
questions.shortcut: The third-child maternity leave case was appealed from the Allahabad High Court.

questions.q: Which of the following new digital facilities was launched in May 2025 by the Union Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment during the 'Ageing with Dignity' event?
options: Employment Exchange Portal for Senior Citizens
questions.solution:
At the 'Ageing with Dignity' event in May 2025, the Ministry launched a One-Stop Senior Citizens Services Portal as a single window for schemes, helplines and services for the elderly.
**Answer: One-Stop Senior Citizens Services Portal**
questions.shortcut: May 2025 'Ageing with Dignity' launch = the one-stop portal for senior citizens.

questions.q: In 2025, which city of Maharashtra achieved 100% segregation, collection and processing of sanitary and biomedical waste, handling an average of 300 to 350 kg of sanitary waste daily?
questions.solution:
Karad in Satara district became the first city in Maharashtra to achieve 100% segregation, collection and processing of sanitary and biomedical waste, handling about 300-350 kg of sanitary waste every day.
**Answer: Karad**
questions.shortcut: Link '100% sanitary waste processing' with Karad (Satara district).

questions.q: Who authored the book 'Test Cricket: A History', released in 2025?
questions.solution:
'Test Cricket: A History', tracing the game's longest format from 1877 to the present, was written by cricket writer Tim Wigmore and released in 2025.
**Answer: Tim Wigmore**
questions.shortcut: The 2025 definitive Test-cricket history is by Tim Wigmore.

questions.q: Which chess player, besides Gukesh, received the Arjuna Award in 2025?
questions.solution:
For the 2024 season, the Arjuna Award in chess went to world champion D. Gukesh and Woman Grandmaster Vantika Agrawal.
**Answer: Vantika Agrawal**
questions.shortcut: Gukesh's co-awardee in chess was Vantika Agrawal.

questions.q: Which of the following documentaries did the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) launch to explain its functions to the public in June 2025?
questions.solution:
In June 2025 the RBI released the documentary 'RBI Unlocked: Beyond the Rupee', explaining how the central bank manages currency, inflation and the financial system.
**Answer: RBI Unlocked: Beyond the Rupee**
questions.shortcut: The RBI's 2025 public documentary title begins 'RBI Unlocked'.

questions.q: Which Indian Ministry launched the Bharat Forecasting System (BFS) on 26 May 2025 to provide weather predictions with a 6-km resolution?
options: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
questions.solution:
The Bharat Forecasting System, launched by the Ministry of Earth Sciences, works at a 6-km grid resolution - the highest of any operational weather model - and is run by the India Meteorological Department.
**Answer: Ministry of Earth Sciences**
questions.shortcut: BFS is a weather model → Ministry of Earth Sciences (IMD).

questions.q: Which startup was selected in April 2025 to build India's first sovereign Indic LLM under the IndiaAI Mission?
questions.solution:
The IndiaAI Mission under MeitY selected Bengaluru-based Sarvam AI in April 2025 to build India's first sovereign large language model for Indian languages.
**Answer: Sarvam AI**
questions.shortcut: Sovereign Indic LLM = Sarvam AI.

questions.q: As reported in May 2025, the study by Climate Trends, a Delhi-based research consultancy, examined NASA satellite data of the Himalayan glaciers from 2000-2023 to evaluate the impact of which of the following on Himalayan snow?
questions.solution:
The Climate Trends analysis of NASA satellite data found that black carbon deposition is darkening Himalayan snow and accelerating its melt over 2000-2023.
**Answer: Black Carbon**
questions.shortcut: The snow-darkening pollutant in the Himalaya study: black carbon.

questions.q: The National Conference on Good Governance, organised by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG), was held in which of the following places in January 2025?
questions.solution:
DARPG's National Conference on Good Governance Practices was held in January 2025 at Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
**Answer: Gandhinagar**
questions.shortcut: Jan 2025 DARPG good-governance conference → Gandhinagar.

questions.q: What was the theme of the 78th World Health Assembly, 2025, held in Geneva in May 2025?
options: Health for All: Building Resilient Systems
Universal Health Coverage: A Global Need
questions.solution:
The 78th World Health Assembly met in Geneva in May 2025 under the theme 'One World for Health'.
**Answer: One World for Health**
questions.shortcut: WHA 78 (2025) theme: One World for Health.

questions.q: As announced by the Government of India, as on 7 July 2025, how many biotech startups does India have, compared to just 50 a decade ago?
questions.solution:
The government stated that India's biotech startup count had grown from about 50 in 2014 to nearly 11,000 by July 2025.
**Answer: Nearly 11,000**
questions.shortcut: Biotech startups: 50 a decade ago to ~11,000 now.

questions.q: Which of the following awards recognises children's book writers from 22 languages?
questions.solution:
The Sahitya Akademi's Bal Sahitya Puraskar is given annually to writers of outstanding children's literature in the 22 scheduled languages.
**Answer: Bal Sahitya Puraskar**
questions.shortcut: Sahitya Akademi's children's-literature award = Bal Sahitya Puraskar.

questions.q: On 16 May 2025, the Supreme Court invalidated the Indian Government's orders passed in which years, allowing ex-post facto environmental clearances?
questions.solution:
The Supreme Court struck down the Centre's 2017 notification and the 2021 office memorandum, holding that ex-post facto (retrospective) environmental clearances are contrary to environmental law.
**Answer: 2017 and 2021**
questions.shortcut: The ex-post facto EC verdict quashed the 2017 notification and the 2021 OM.

questions.q: Where did the chemical factory blast occur on 30 June 2025?
questions.solution:
The explosion at the Sigachi Industries chemical plant occurred at Pashamylaram in Sangareddy district of Telangana on 30 June 2025.
**Answer: Sangareddy**
questions.shortcut: June 2025 Sigachi Industries reactor blast → Sangareddy (Telangana).

questions.q: Which state became the third Indian state to be recognised as fully functionally literate, under the ULLAS - New India Literacy Programme, in June 2025?
questions.solution:
Tripura was declared fully functionally literate in June 2025, joining Mizoram and Goa as the third state so recognised under the ULLAS - New India Literacy Programme (after the UT of Ladakh).
**Answer: Tripura**
questions.shortcut: ULLAS fully-literate order: Mizoram → Goa → Tripura (Ladakh first overall).

questions.q: Which of the following shifted its Andhra Pradesh regional office to Vijayawada, inaugurating the new premises on 16 June 2025?
options: Securities and Exchange Board of India
questions.solution:
The Reserve Bank of India inaugurated its new regional office for Andhra Pradesh at Vijayawada on 16 June 2025, shifting operations from Hyderabad.
**Answer: Reserve Bank of India**
questions.shortcut: New RBI regional office for Andhra Pradesh (2025) → Vijayawada.

questions.q: India set a new Guinness World Record in 2025 for the largest human formation of which of the following symbols?
questions.solution:
In 2025 India entered the Guinness World Records for the largest human formation of the Ashoka Chakra, created by thousands of participants standing as one emblem.
**Answer: Ashoka Chakra**
questions.shortcut: 2025 human-formation record → Ashoka Chakra.

questions.q: India won the ICC Women's U19 T20 World Cup 2025 by defeating which country in the final?
questions.solution:
India defended their title by beating South Africa by 9 wickets in the final of the ICC Women's U19 T20 World Cup 2025 held in Malaysia.
**Answer: South Africa**
questions.shortcut: U19 Women's T20 WC 2025 final: India beat South Africa.

questions.q: Which sport had the most Arjuna Award recipients in January 2025?
questions.solution:
When the Arjuna Awards for the 2024 season were conferred in January 2025, shooting accounted for the largest number of recipients among all sports.
**Answer: Shooting**
questions.shortcut: In the January 2025 Arjuna list, shooting led the count.
